topic: conor orr grades all 10 nfl head coaching hires for 2026

text: The NFL head coaching carousel has finally come to a stop
New hires are gonna shake out, and it's fascinating to see how teams approach finding their next leader
Conor Orr is taking a closer look at all ten new head coaching hires
Different strategies were used to find new coaches, from promoting coordinators to bringing in outsiders
Some teams are trying to replicate the success of other franchises by hiring coaches who worked under successful head coaches
Other teams are taking a more unconventional approach to finding their new coaches
New coaches bring various skills and experience to the table, such as expertise in offense or defense
Experience working with specific types of players is also a key factor in the new coaching hires
The skills of new coaches must mesh with the teams they're joining, making it a complex puzzle to put together
Coaching hires are about building a foundation for long-term success, not just the next season
Even if some coaches don't pan out right away, they could still set their teams up for success down the line
The coaching hires and their potential for long-term success make the NFL off-season intriguing
